translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Apokalips
book.title: Apokalips Gamin kuuk Buŋ bayniiji ɗo Yaaya

content: Ɗubil ka Buŋdi ka beeƴiŋkar paantu. Min ŋa paantu, nu taltu kaal kaak gal min kuwa ka samaaner. Ŋu berji kerle kaak ŋaa pilin̰ bee kaak sugulgul, wer kaak seetinnay goyiyo.
Kaal-ak piliig bee-aka. Min ŋa piliiga, mooy astu amal min atta ar mooy ku baalel. Mooy-ak nam gootit pato. Ek di wer astu gondik dulum.
Min ɗo mooy-ak astu amal bagi. Bag-ak terin̰tu ɗo adiy ka kiɗar okin̰ji. Ŋu berco gudurre ar ta erindilel.
Ŋu kaawco a ŋu teenno maan kaak balan̰, wala gan̰o, wala atay, illa ŋu atke gee kuuk Buŋ balco diye tompo ɗo uŋninco di.
Kar gay, ŋu toɗco a ŋuu deenno gemo, illa ŋu kaawco a ŋuu taaɓiyin̰ gee nam koyin beeƴ. Taaɓinco-at gay, ar raɗe ka erindilel.
Ɗo wiktin taar-at, gee aliit muut sa, ŋu gasgitɗo. Ŋu rakaat muutu ho taar gay gaɗa serek minninco.
Bagi-ak ar pisay kuuk ɓaa garta. Ɗo kaƴco ŋu gin gamin ar kadumuulna ku daabner ho wijeenco gay ar ta geemir.
Duruwco bolok ar ta daatir ho saaŋco gay ar ku boorir.
Kar ɗo goŋguminco, ŋu is saapinna ku hadinner. Kar gezgirco gay, ala ridi-di-di ar pisay kuuk ɗaan̰a puusna ho ŋu rees ɓaa garta.
Bagi-ak aayiyco gin kope ar ta erindilel. Iŋ aayiyco-ak gay, ŋuu taaɓiyin̰ gee koyin beeƴ.

Meen̰co gay, ɗubil rakki kaak goy tatkaw ka ŋuur kuuk goy ɗo bee kaak sugulgul-aka. Ɗubil-ak, ŋu kolaag « Abadoon » iŋ kaaw ta *Yuudinnar, ho iŋ kaaw ta Grek gay « Apoliyoon ». Siŋ-ak ɗiya aman : « Ka nige wernar. »
Taaɓin taat awalle bire. Min taar-an diigin seer asa pey aarti.
Min ŋaar-ak, ɗubil ka Buŋdi ka bijigiƴiŋkar paantu. Min ŋa paantu, nu dortu gaaƴ amila min ɗo geepay kuuk pooɗ kuuk goy *wer ka satkiner ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi.
Gaaƴ-at kaawtu ɗo ɗubil ka Buŋdi ka bijigiƴiŋkar aman : « Pikgu ɗubal ku Buŋdi kuuk pooɗ kuuk ŋu ɗuuntu ɗo barre kaak ŋu koliy Epraat. »

Hiyya, ŋu pikiigu. Ɗubal kuuk pooɗ-ak, min daayum ŋu era ya elgo-at, koy-at, ƴiriy-at ho pat-at yaa ase. Ŋu era a ŋu ɓaa dee gee ku duniiner : gee-ak werinco subba, ŋu gas izinne a ŋuu deen̰ wer ka rakki.
Kar nu taltu dalŋay askirna astu. Ŋu kaawiidu a ŋu miy seer maliyuun (200 000 000).

Dalŋay-ak, nu tal ŋu is saapinnay ku gartar. Saapinnay-ak dindik ar ako, balan̰ ciɗit ar samaane ho mirgiti. Kar kaƴ ku pisiyco gay ar ku boornar ho min ɗo biŋkico amila ako iŋ mooy iŋ maan ar ak ta baruukiner.
Gamin kuuk amila min ɗo biŋkinco-ak dee gee dakina : gee okin̰co werinco subba, wer ka rakki ŋu deeyigu.
Pisay-ak, gudurrico amila min ɗo biŋkico ho min ɗo aayiyco oki. Aayiyco gay ar ku aalnal. Ŋu gin kaƴ ho ŋu umiy gee.

Iŋ taaɓin taat asco-at oki, gee daarin̰ goy di kuuk bal mate. Iŋ taar-an oki, ŋu bal jipte goyin̰co kaak samaanno. Ŋu bal pikin botol ta aariɗdi. Ŋu abdiya misa margin kuuk maaniico di siytu iŋ daabne, poddine, hadinne kaak mirgiti, dambay, wal iŋ atay. Margin-ak tallo, dorro ho jaawɗo. Kar gay, ŋu bal rase botilco.
Gee-ak rasɗo goyin̰co : dee ka geemir, olguwco, ɓaaƴin̰co kaak mun̰jam, wala kokunuwco.
